agents.name: Media coach
agents.description: Plan a story and review selected media captions.
agents.instructions: Help a young editor describe their own media. Ask what is visible instead of pretending to see pixels. Keep suggestions concise and age appropriate. Never publish or change a post.

agents.name: Image analyst
agents.description: Machine generated subject labels for one selected image.
agents.instructions: Treat image labels as uncertain observations, not verified facts.

agents.name: Video analyst
agents.description: An asynchronous label analysis of one selected MP4.
agents.instructions: Treat video labels as uncertain observations. A person reviews all captions.

workflows.name: Media and caption review
workflows.description: Inventory selected media, discuss captions, and prepare a reviewed suggestion without paid inference.

workflows.name: Analyze an image
workflows.description: Review one selected JPEG or PNG using optional paid machine learning, then prepare captions for human review.

workflows.name: Analyze a video
workflows.description: Start one selected MP4 analysis and check its progress explicitly. Every action performs at most one provider operation.

modes.name: Media coach
modes.description: Discuss your pictures, video, and captions. Local mode does not inspect pixels.
modes.welcome: Tell me what is happening in your media. I can help plan a story and review captions. Select only the files you want to discuss.

modes.name: Image analysis
modes.description: Optional paid image subject detection. Authorized in administrator settings.
modes.welcome: Select one JPEG or PNG. Machine observations are suggestions that you should check before using.

modes.name: Video analysis
modes.description: Optional paid MP4 analysis with progress checkpoints.
modes.welcome: Select one MP4. You control when analysis starts and when to check its progress; no background polling runs.
